evidence: NOTE: Only ambiguous claim. An MSC 6.00AX C function whose whole body is inline _asm reproduces all 306 bytes and 29 fixups exactly (work/asmrole/c1B05/v_total.c, /AL /Os /Gs /Zi, _DATA=55B3:3BE2; local-slot order depends on the local names, NAME-2/4). Its neighbours f_1B05_0008 and f_1B05_0178 are not MSC output in any form (no 'mov sp,bp' after asm-only code, ASM-1; and/mov-0/les idioms, IDIOM-1), and both of its boundaries are even, so the bytes cannot prove a separate C object. Treating it as C would need an invented 3-object split (asm | C | asm) of one LZSS module sharing one state block; kept GENUINE. Either way the body is hand-written assembly text, not compiler-generated C.
